title: UsageAtlas - Free AI usage tracker for 14 providers
excerpt: Free, open-source AI usage tracker for 14 providers, including Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot. See supported token history, credits and limits.
content_html:
Free. Open source. Made for your desktop.

All your AI coding usage insights.
One beautiful view.

Track AI coding usage across 14 providers. Token history, available cost estimates, credits, and usage limits in one free, open-source desktop app.

Download freeExplore the app

macOS, Windows & LinuxNo account needed

A closer look

01 / 04

Your day, across every tool. Usage, cost, and room to keep going.

Actual app screenshots

UsageAtlas / Today

Your day, across every tool. Usage, cost, and room to keep going.

14 providers. One home for the tools you build with.

  • CodexHistory & usage limits

  • Claude CodeHistory & usage limits

  • CursorPlan & API usage

  • OpenCodeLocal session history

  • Antigravity CLILocal tokens & history

  • Pi / OMPLocal tokens & history

  • Muse CodeLocal tokens & history

  • GitHub CopilotReported quotas & credits

  • WarpMonthly & add-on credits

  • Kimi CodeUsage windows & resets

  • Kilo CodeCredit balance & Kilo Pass

  • Factory / DroidAllowances & balances

  • AmpAgent credits & Orb hours

  • QoderPersonal & shared credits

Local history where your tools record it. Credits and limits where your providers report them.
Find your provider and get started

THE BIG PICTURE. THE LITTLE DETAILS.

Less checking.
More building.

A quick glance before your next task.
A little more detail when you need it.

USAGE HISTORY

Today makes more sense
with a little history.

See your tokens, requests, and estimated cost over time. Compare with the previous period to spot what changed.

7, 30, or 90 daysYour full history

MODEL MIX

Meet your most-used models.

See which models do the heavy lifting, and how your tokens are split between them.

Every model your tools report

YOUR WORKING RHYTHM

Find your flow, in the data.

Early starts or late-night sessions? Your activity adds up to a picture of how you work.

Your week, in your local time

A LITTLE HEADS-UP

Keep the flow.
Know your limits.

See your remaining capacity and reset times before you start. Get a quiet notification when it's time to pace yourself.

  • A threshold for each usage window
  • One alert per reset cycle
  • Keeps checking from your tray
Take a closer look

UsageAtlasExample notification

Room for a few more good ideas.

Codex weekly capacity is down to 32%.

YOUR USAGE. YOUR BUSINESS.

Right on your desktop.
Right where it belongs.

Start tracking without creating an account. Your prompts, responses, and coding-tool credentials stay out of the picture.

A backup, if you want one.

Create a free account to save your usage history and restore it on another computer. Sharing it on a public profile is a separate choice.

Read our privacy policy

Public profilesOptional

Your AI work.
Worth sharing.

Give your AI coding activity a home, just like your contributions on GitHub.

  1. Keep your history.

    Sign in to the desktop app and save your usage to your free account.

  2. Make it yours.

    Choose a handle, add a bio, and link your GitHub or website.

  3. Share when you're ready.

    Publish your stats, activity, tools, and models. Hide your page anytime.

View demo profileCreate your profile

Your profile stays private until you publish.

Screenshots from the demo profile. Public stats reflect saved usage.

Yes. UsageAtlas is free and open source. Local tracking needs no account, and optional cloud save is free too.

A SMALL APP. A CLEARER PICTURE.

Make room for clarity.

All your AI usage, one download away.
Free and open source, on the desktop you already use.

Windows 10 or later

Squirrel installer with automatic updates for 64-bit Windows.

macOS builds are signed and notarized. Windows installers are not yet code-signed and may show a SmartScreen prompt. SHA-256 checksums are included with every release.
